title: Calanova Collection – Apartments & Penthouses Costa del Sol with sea views in Calanova Golf
summary: Calanova Collection is a fantastic new development of stunning contemporary apartments and penthouses with sea views in the sought-after area of Calanova Golf, just a stone’s throw from La Cala de Mijas.
description:
Calanova Collection is a fantastic new development of stunning contemporary apartments and penthouses with sea views in the sought-after area of Calanova Golf, just a stone’s throw from La Cala de Mijas.

The popularity of this beautiful coastal town and its surroundings is no surprise. Located on the Costa del Sol, La Cala de Mijas is renowned for its sandy beaches, charming old town, and excellent choice of restaurants, bars, and shops. It is also home to several top golf courses, including the prestigious Calanova Golf Club. Whether you enjoy hiking, golf, water sports, or simply relaxing at a beachfront chiringuito, this location offers everything you could wish for. With Málaga International Airport only 25 minutes away and Marbella and Puerto Banús just 20 minutes in the other direction, Calanova Collection apartments enjoy a truly privileged location.

The development’s panoramic views over the Andalusian countryside and the Mediterranean Sea simply have to be seen. Calanova Collection features sleek, modern interiors with high-quality specifications throughout. Resort-style amenities include two swimming pools (one an infinity pool), a fully equipped gym, spa, sauna, and even an indoor golf simulator.

These spacious and bright apartments in Calanova Collection are designed to maximise natural light, with floor-to-ceiling windows and open-plan layouts. Spread across several low-rise blocks within landscaped communal gardens, the homes are fitted with premium details such as Bosch appliances in the kitchens and Hansgrohe taps in the bathrooms.

Ground-floor apartments include terraces, private hot tubs, and in some cases their own garden.

Middle-floor apartments offer large terraces with fantastic views.

Penthouses feature expansive terraces, private hot tubs, and spectacular solariums with breathtaking vistas.

Beyond the luxurious living spaces, Calanova Collection La Cala de Mijas provides unique convenience for golf lovers: the entrance to Calanova Golf Club is less than three minutes’ walk from the development, with underground parking spaces also available for golf buggies. This rare feature allows residents to step straight from home to fairway.

With its prime location between Málaga and Marbella, just minutes from La Cala de Mijas and right next to one of the best golf courses on the Costa del Sol, Calanova Collection apartments and penthouses represent an exceptional opportunity for both lifestyle and investment buyers.
